A2lObjectOptions.description:
What a declaration asks of the a2l backend. Only that backend interprets it.

Nothing here changes the generated c or the meaning of the object; a project that
generates no a2l can leave the whole block out.

export.description:
Whether the object belongs in the a2l file; omitted, it does.

The one a2l option any component may state, not only the producer. Which signals a
calibration engineer needs to see is not a property of whoever happens to write the
variable: a component reading a value from a library it does not own has as good a claim
to measuring it.

Stated by several, the answer is yes if any of them says so - see ``resolve_export``.
export.title: Export

format.description: a2l ``FORMAT`` string, e.g. ``"%8.3"``: total width, then decimal places.
format.title: Format

display_identifier.description: Alternative name shown by the calibration tool.
display_identifier.title: Display Identifier

ComponentDeclaration.description:
One entry of a component interface, in the order the component declared it.

A reference to an object rather than the object itself: the definition lives once, under
``objects``, and is the one the producing component gave. Two components declaring the
same name appear here twice and in ``objects`` once.

name.description: Name of the declared object; a key into the ``objects`` list of the dictionary.
name.title: Name

scope.description: How this component uses the object: ``input``, ``output`` or ``local``.

condition.description: Preprocessor expression this component guarded the declaration with, if any.
condition.title: Condition

Datatype.description:
The base datatypes DDD can allocate storage for.

* ``boolean`` - A truth value, 0 or 1; 1 byte of storage.
* ``uint8`` - Unsigned integer; 1 byte of storage, 0 to 255.
* ``sint8`` - Signed integer; 1 byte of storage, -128 to 127.
* ``uint16`` - Unsigned integer; 2 bytes of storage, 0 to 65535.
* ``sint16`` - Signed integer; 2 bytes of storage, -32768 to 32767.
* ``uint32`` - Unsigned integer; 4 bytes of storage, 0 to 4294967295.
* ``sint32`` - Signed integer; 4 bytes of storage, -2147483648 to 2147483647.
* ``uint64`` - Unsigned integer; 8 bytes of storage, 0 to 18446744073709551615.
* ``sint64`` - Signed integer; 8 bytes of storage, -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807.
* ``float32`` - IEEE 754 single precision floating point; 4 bytes of storage, magnitude up to 3.4028234663852886e+38.
* ``float64`` - IEEE 754 double precision floating point; 8 bytes of storage, magnitude up to 1.7976931348623157e+308.

ObjectKind.description:
What sort of data object a definition describes.

* ``measurement`` - An online value the software writes and the calibration tool only reads.
* ``parameter`` - A single calibratable constant.
* ``value_block`` - An array of calibratable constants.
* ``curve`` - A one dimensional calibratable table over one axis.
* ``map`` - A two dimensional calibratable table over two axes.
* ``axis`` - Shared axis points a curve or map is interpolated over.

ResolvedInstance.description:
One variable whose datatype is a structure.

Kept apart from ``ResolvedObject`` rather than widening it: an object with no datatype
and no limits would turn every reader of those two fields into a branch, and they are read
unconditionally in a dozen places on the strength of always being there.

name.description: Name of the variable; its c identifier and the root of every leaf path.
name.title: Name

type.description: Name of the structure it is, which is the c type of the declaration.
type.title: Type

kind.description: ``measurement`` or ``parameter``: what the whole object is, and so how it is qualified.

description.description: What the object is; the comment in the generated c.
description.title: Description

shape.description:
Array dimensions of the variable itself, empty for a single structure.

An array of structures reaches the a2l as its elements: there is no one address that
describes ``cell[0].raw`` and ``cell[1].raw`` at once, so each element contributes its own
leaves at its own path.
shape.title: Shape

volatile.description: Whether the declaration carries ``volatile``, which qualifies the whole object.
volatile.title: Volatile

section.description:
Linker section the whole structure is placed in; its members have no placement
of their own.
section.title: Section

condition.description: Preprocessor condition of the producing declaration, if any.
condition.title: Condition

owner.description: Component owning the object; ``None`` only when the project is inconsistent.
owner.title: Owner

consumers.description: Components declaring the object as an input, sorted.
consumers.title: Consumers

local.description: Owned exclusively by ``owner``; no other component may declare it.
local.title: Local

a2l.description: What the whole object asks of the a2l; a member may ask for more of its own.

ResolvedLeaf.description:
One member of one structured variable, at the end of one access path.

The flattening. A structure reaches the a2l as an object per member rather than as an a2l
structure, so this is the form that backend consumes - an ordinary object in every respect
but its name, which is a path rather than an identifier.

path.description:
The c expression that reads this member: ``Inlet.latest.value``, ``Inlet.cell[2].raw``.

Both the name the a2l gives the object and the symbol it links it to. Written the way it
would be written in c, so that a reader of the a2l, of the generated c and of a map file is
looking at one string rather than at three spellings of one thing.
path.title: Path

instance.description: Name of the variable this leaf belongs to, which is the root of ``path``.
instance.title: Instance

kind.description: Taken from the variable: every leaf of one object has the storage class of the whole.

description.description: What this member is; the a2l long identifier.
description.title: Description

unit.description: Physical unit, from the member or from the type it names.
unit.title: Unit

conversion.description: Always present: the member's conversion, or the identity when none was given.
conversion.title: Conversion

limits.description: Always present: stated, or derived from the storage - a bitfield's from its width.

shape.description: Array dimensions of this member; empty for a scalar.
shape.title: Shape

bits.description:
Width in bits when the member is a c bitfield.

Such a leaf has no address of its own - ``&s.ready`` does not compile - so it reaches no
a2l until a build tells DDD both where the word is and which bits inside it to read.
bits.title: Bits

volatile.description: From the variable, which carries the qualifier for all of its members at once.
volatile.title: Volatile

section.description:
Linker section of the structure this member belongs to; a member has no placement
of its own.
section.title: Section

condition.description: Preprocessor condition of the producing declaration, if any.
condition.title: Condition

owner.description: Component owning the variable this leaf belongs to.
owner.title: Owner

consumers.description: Components declaring the variable as an input, sorted.
consumers.title: Consumers

a2l.description: The member's own a2l options; a member may be kept out of the file on its own.

ResolvedMember.description:
One member of a structure, as the c templates need it to declare the member.

Only what a declaration takes. The meaning of the member - its unit, its conversion, its
limits - travels with the *leaf* instead, because that is the form the a2l consumes and
there is no second place a reader should have to look.

description.description: What the member is, for a comment beside its declaration.
description.title: Description

datatype.description: Storage of the member when it is a base one; ``None`` when it names a structure.

type.title: Type

shape.description: Array dimensions, empty for a scalar.
shape.title: Shape

bits.description: Width in bits when the member is a c bitfield; ``None`` when it is not.
bits.title: Bits

ResolvedObject.description: One data object, with every derived property already worked out.

name.description: Name of the object, unique across the whole project; its c and a2l identifier.
name.title: Name

kind.description: Which sort of object this is, taken from the definition that produced it.

description.description: What the object is; the a2l long identifier and the comment in the generated c.
description.title: Description

unit.description: Physical unit, as the declaring components agreed on it.
unit.title: Unit

conversion.description: Always present: the declared conversion, or the identity when none was given.
conversion.title: Conversion

limits.description: Always present: the explicit limits, or the range the datatype and conversion imply.

shape.description:
Storage shape, empty for a scalar; for a curve or a map it comes from its axes.

Every dimension is at least one, like the ``dimensions`` and ``size`` it derives from.
shape.title: Shape

init.description: Raw initial value, nested to match ``shape``; ``null`` means zero initialised.

section.description:
Linker section the producing declaration placed the object in; ``null`` for the
toolchain's defaults.
section.title: Section

volatile.description:
Generate the object ``volatile``: stated by every declaration, on every kind.

Calibration data carries it as ``const volatile``, which is what a value the calibration
tool changes in a running ecu needs - see the field of the same name on the authored
definition. The default is kept although a definition may no longer omit it, so that a
dictionary dumped by an older DDD still reads back; that is what ``DICTIONARY_FORMAT``
exists to make safe.
volatile.title: Volatile

condition.description: Preprocessor condition of the producing declaration, if any.

references.description: Other objects this one refers to, keyed by field name (``axis``, ``x_axis``, ...).
references.title: References

owner.description: Component owning the object; ``None`` only when the project is inconsistent.
owner.title: Owner

consumers.description: Components declaring the object as an input, sorted; empty when nothing reads it.
consumers.title: Consumers

local.description: Owned exclusively by ``owner``; no other component may declare it.
local.title: Local

a2l.description: What the author asked for in the ``a2l`` block. Only the a2l backend interprets it.

ResolvedStruct.description:
One structure, in an order a c file can be written out in.

The order of ``DataDictionary.types`` matters and is not alphabetical: a structure
appears after every structure it nests, because a c compiler needs the nested one to be
complete first. The members keep the order the author wrote them in, which is the order the
compiler lays them out.

name.description: Name of the structure, which is the name of the generated typedef.
name.title: Name

description.description: What the structure is, for a comment above it.
description.title: Description

Scope.description:
Direction of a variable with respect to the declaring component.

* ``input`` - The component reads the variable; another component has to produce it.
* ``output`` - The component writes the variable; exactly one component may do so.
* ``local`` - The component owns the variable exclusively; no other component may use it.
enumDescriptions: The component reads the variable; another component has to produce it.
The component writes the variable; exactly one component may do so.
The component owns the variable exclusively; no other component may use it.

description:
The resolved data of one project.

What ``ddd dump`` writes and every backend reads. Unlike the description files, this one
is produced rather than authored: every derived property is already worked out, so a
consumer never has to repeat the resolution and two consumers can never disagree about it.

format.description:
Version of this document format, raised only when the shape of the document changes.

Stamped so that a dictionary archived next to a delivery can be read back years later by
a version of DDD that can say "this file is newer than I understand" rather than misread
it. It does not follow the version of the tool.
format.title: Format

name.description: Name of the project, from the root project description.
name.title: Name

description.description: Free text from the root project description.
description.title: Description

source.description: Name of the root description file, for reference in generated comments.
source.title: Source

components.description: Every component of the project, including those of its sub-projects.
components.title: Components

objects.description: Sorted by name, so that every backend produces a stable output.
objects.title: Objects

enums.description: Distinct enumerations used by the objects, sorted by name.
enums.title: Enums

types.description:
The structures the project declares, each after every structure it nests.

Dependency order rather than alphabetical, because a template that simply loops over them
has to be able to write them out as they come: c needs a nested structure to be complete
before the one that contains it.
types.title: Types

instances.description: Variables whose datatype is a structure, sorted by name.
instances.title: Instances

leaves.description:
Every member of every structured variable, flattened, sorted by path.

Written out rather than worked out on demand, because the dictionary is a produced
document: a generator DDD does not ship reads it without importing python, and no backend
should repeat resolution the analysis has already done.
leaves.title: Leaves
